name: Max
source:
An attractive woman that Emily meets at the bar Roy frequents. 

She seems open to spending time with Emily....

[spoiler]Max is actually one of Roy's past female corrupted conquests. 

It is implied that she was initially resistant to becoming Roy's sex slave before Roy finished corrupting her. 

Currently, she is subservient to Roy and she actively helping him enact his plan to corrupt Emily. 

[spoiler]As part of the plan, she enters into a Lesbian relationship with Emily. 

Once Emily is invested in their relationship, she dumps Emily at the opportune moment to further break Emily's psyche for Roy.
